results.pair_summary: Both documents define the core types and operations for the Chronos-R1 runtime module. Document A provides a detailed behavioral specification with explicit transition logic, priority rules, and numbered invariants (INV1-8). Document B presents a structural interface view with operation grouping (domain-api, pure-ops) and testing stubs but lacks the specific internal constraints found in A.
results.integration_rationale: Document A is the authoritative specification for Delta3 Kernel compliance due to its rigorous invariant definitions and detailed kernel-transition logic. Document B should be merged into A to adopt its cleaner operation categorization (e.g., separating pure-ops from kernel-boundary) and to incorporate its inspection/testing interfaces, ensuring a single source of truth that combines structural clarity with behavioral precision.
